title: A Second Pet's Own Autoship Everyday Subscription for an Item the Household Already Receives
content:
**Enrollment desk — second pet on the same item**

This rule sets the weeks between shipments of a new Autoship Everyday subscription under Tailwise Autoship that a customer opens for a pet for an item the household already receives on another pet's Autoship, written as the new subscription's frequency in weeks. The new subscription ships the same units per shipment as the existing Autoship carries, and its first ship date is the date the customer chooses.

The weeks between shipments of a second pet's own Autoship for an item the household already receives are worked out only after the existing Autoship of that item has been re-sized to its own pet's usage.

Restated: until the existing Autoship of the item has been re-sized to its own pet's usage, the new pet's weeks between shipments are not worked out. The new subscription is an enrollment like any other and meets the Tailwise Autoship enrollment conditions and the rules on holding several subscriptions per customer, item and pet.

## Opening the subscription: `enroll_everyday_autoship_7ae73b8d`

**Capability.** Opens a new Autoship Everyday subscription in the customer's own name for one standard catalog item for one of their pets. On success a new subscription is created in status `pending_first_shipment`, linked to the pet, carrying the item number, description, price and shipping weight per unit given, the units per shipment, the weeks between shipments and the first ship date given, with nothing billed yet. The customer sees the new subscription and its reference number at once; the first shipment is charged on the first ship date.

**How it is invoked.** The tool authorizes recurring charges on the customer's card, so it belongs to the customer: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | The customer reference number of the account the subscription is opened on, from the customer profile lookup | Id |
| `pet_id` | The reference number of the pet the item is for, from the pet profiles lookup | Id |
| `rx_prescription_id` | The reference number of a linked prescription; standard catalog items carry none, so it is the empty value the household's existing Autoship of the item shows for its linked prescription | Id, empty for standard catalog items |
| `sku` | The item number, exactly as the household's existing Autoship of the item shows it | TW- followed by 6 digits |
| `item_description` | The catalog description of the item, exactly as the household's existing Autoship of the item shows it | Verbatim, character for character, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion |
| `unit_price_usd` | The catalog price of one unit in USD, as the existing Autoship of the item shows it | Number with 2 decimal places; no rounding is applied by the tool |
| `item_weight_lb` | The shipping weight of one unit in pounds, as the existing Autoship of the item shows it | Number with 1 decimal place |
| `quantity` | The units of the item each shipment carries | Integer, whole units |
| `frequency_weeks` | The number of weeks between shipments | Integer, whole weeks |
| `next_ship_date` | The first ship date the customer chose | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, store-local, no time part |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with six fields: `autoship_id` (the new subscription's reference number), `variant_name` (always `Autoship Everyday`), `status` (always `pending_first_shipment`), `quantity`, `frequency_weeks` and `next_ship_date`. A returned `autoship_id` with status `pending_first_shipment` is the success receipt.
